records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company's quarterly financial data is subject to seasonal fluctuations, and its second and third quarter financial results have historically reflected higher travel demand than its first and fourth quarter financial results.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the three months ended March 31, 2025 and 2024, the Company recognized approximately $4.3 billion and $4.0 billion, respectively, of passenger revenue for tickets that were included in Advance ticket sales at the beginning of those periods.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Republic currently operates 66 regional aircraft under capacity purchase agreements ("CPAs") with United that have terms through 2037.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Passenger revenue increased $547 million, or 4.8%, in the first quarter of 2025 as compared to the year-ago period, primarily due to a 4.9% increase in capacity, a 3.8% increase in the number of passengers flown and a 1.2% increase in yield.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cargo revenue increased $38 million, or 9.7%, in the first quarter of 2025 as compared to the year-ago period, primarily due to higher tonnage and yields.
